warn.summary: Add the missing headers or tighten the weak ones at your web host, CDN or web server.

generic: X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN if you embed your own pages), or a CSP frame-ancestors rule.
Content-Security-Policy: start in report-only mode, then avoid 'unsafe-inline' and '*' in script sources.
Cloudflare, Netlify, Vercel and most hosts let you add response headers in their settings or a config file.

fail.summary: Several security headers are missing. Add them at your web host, CDN or web server.

generic: X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN if you embed your own pages), or a CSP frame-ancestors rule.
Content-Security-Policy: start in report-only mode, then enforce once nothing breaks.
Cloudflare, Netlify, Vercel and most hosts let you add response headers in their settings or a config file.
